newsitem.title: USA: Nynex says N.H. panel approves merger.
newsitem.headline: Nynex says N.H. panel approves merger.

text.p: Nynex Corp said Monday the New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission approved its $22 billion merger with Bell Atlantic Corp.
The approval means five of the seven NYNEX states have either approved the merger or have not sought jurisdiction over it, Nynex said.
The merger was announced on April 22, 1996.
New York and Vermont regulators are now reviewing the merger, Nynex said.

Massachusetts and Rhode Island have not sought to assert jurisdiction over it, although Massachusetts is reviewing the merger within the context of its general supervisory authority over telephone operations, the company added.
The merged company would serve 39 million telephone access lines in 13 states and more than 4 million cellular customers, Nynex said.
Nynex said it expects all reviews to be completed shortly and that the merger should close in the first quarter.
